review.label: NON_EQUIVALENT
review.rationale: The overlay replaces a conditional check `if proposal.policy_version != COMMITMENT_POLICY_VERSION:` with `if False:`, which unconditionally disables the policy version enforcement. Under the original code, any commitment proposal whose `policy_version` differs from `COMMITMENT_POLICY_VERSION` would raise a `GlhsInvariantError` with message 'commitment_proposal_policy_mismatch', halting further processing. Under the mutated code, that branch is dead code and can never execute, so a mismatched policy version will silently pass through to the subsequent `consent_version` check. This produces an observable behavioral difference: inputs with `proposal.policy_version != COMMITMENT_POLICY_VERSION` that previously raised an exception will no longer raise one, changing the observable output (exception vs. continued execution) for those inputs.
